how_to_run: Run each prompt with the skill and without it in fresh sessions. Use generated or user-owned fixtures. Grade the transcript for exact-source transcription, two-pass timestamp confirmation, caption interval verification and correct routing to neighbouring skills.
notes: The originating failure timed one upload from a related lyric video, accepted a transcription window that ended before the requested words, and checked caption appearance in one frame instead of checking synchronisation. Fixtures use neutral wording; the behavioural mechanism is the regression target.

evals.name: approximate-quote-from-url
evals.prompt: can you grab this yt clip where she says something like 'pack my bag now you're lifting it'? want a tight mp4 and burn the actual words in, not my rough wording
assertions: Transcribes the exact downloaded source rather than timing from a related upload or transcript page
Uses prompted and unprompted word timestamps and refuses an ambiguous match
Keeps locator wording separate from verified caption wording
Checks caption absence, presence and absence around the reported interval before delivery
evals.history: Neutral regression for the related-source and early-caption failures. Supply a generated fixture URL when running it.

evals.name: local-file-explicit-timestamps
evals.prompt: Downloads/interview final.mp4 - cut 42.4 to 47.1, one sec handles, caption should read `We can ship this on Friday.` and save next to it
assertions: Uses explicit source timestamps without unnecessary quote discovery
Burns the supplied caption only from 1.0 to 5.7 seconds in the output clip
Verifies duration plus audio and video streams
Does not alter the source file
evals.history: Covers the deterministic timestamp path and punctuation-safe caption file.

evals.name: clean-clip-without-captions
evals.prompt: clip the bit in demo.mov where he says 'open the settings panel' - half a second either side, no subs please
assertions: Uses quote timing from the exact local source
Still confirms the quote survives in the final clip
Does not invent caption or styling work
evals.history: Tests the caption escape hatch without weakening quote verification.

evals.name: thumbnail-near-miss
evals.prompt: pull a strong frame from this interview and make a YouTube thumbnail with the guest cut out and a big three-word headline
assertions: Routes to video-thumbnails instead of video-clipping
Does not transcribe speech or create a short video excerpt
evals.history: Near-miss boundary with the existing video-thumbnails skill.
